payload.claim: `_render_new_failure` restates, rather than extracts and imports, logic the repo already has twice for turning a `NewFailure` into `gate`/`file`/`line`/`code`/`message` text — `saffron/phases/implement.py:194-208`'s `repair_prompt` (`f"{n.failure.file}:{n.failure.line or '?'} "` when `n.failure.file`) and `saffron/report/pr_body.py:255-272`'s `_failure_rows`. Per this lens's 'One source' question, a third hand-rolled renderer is the thing to flag rather than add to; it also quietly diverges from `repair_prompt`'s `line or '?'` (which renders `?` for a true `line == 0`) by using `line is not None`, so the two call sites now disagree on what a present-but-falsy line renders as, with no single definition either could be checked against.
